newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices sharply higher.

text.p: Arabica prices in the Bremen coffee market jumped $13-19 on the week per 50 kg fob after $8-10 last week although profit-taking last curbed rallies which had produced 2-1/2 year highs in New York on Wednesday.
Traders reported thin sales as buyers shunned the market and instead drew down stocks.
Arabica differentials firmed with the exception of nearby Brazils which were very competitive for March/April shipment.
Kenyan/Tanzanian auction prices rose sharply on overseas demand.
Robustas rose only slightly amid comfortably availability.
